continuity: RFA's March 16 report quotes a March 13 Houaphanh notice and official confirmation that ten traditional/local posts closed while four international posts stayed open. Exact gate identities and later reopening remain unestablished.

By 2022-09-01, Laos had authorized provinces to reopen local and traditional border checkpoints under controls. This is later national permission, not proof of the reopening date or actual operation of all ten unnamed Houaphanh posts. No continuous closure through 2022 or beyond is established. Notification 1342/PMO dated 2020-12-10 also permits temporary necessary agricultural exports at Ban Dan–Xiengmouang, with dates still to be set. This is limited formal permission; the unnamed March roster does not establish that Ban Dan was one of the ten posts.

unresolved: Names and exact locations of the ten affected local posts are unresolved. A whole Laos–Vietnam border line would overstate this provincial subset.
